prompt: We tested four ropes for the garden swing, and the green one is (short).
explanation_ru: Сравниваются четыре верёвки, поэтому нужна превосходная степень с артиклем the — the shortest.

prompt: My sister says adopting our rescue dog was (happy) day of her life.
explanation_ru: Выбирается один день из всей жизни (of her life), поэтому используется превосходная степень the happiest.

prompt: Could you show me which of these four school bags costs ___?
explanation_ru: Сравниваются четыре сумки, поэтому нужна превосходная степень наречия little — the least. Частая ошибка — ставить сравнительную степень (less / the less) или образовывать форму через most.

prompt: Mia didn't take the hill path because it runs (far) than the river trail.
explanation_ru: Союз than и сравнение двух маршрутов требуют сравнительной степени наречия far — further или farther.

prompt: Among my five cousins, Marek is the most young, so everyone helps him.
answer: Among my five cousins, Marek is the youngest, so everyone helps him.
accepted_answers: Among my five cousins, Marek is the youngest, so everyone helps him.
explanation_ru: Короткое прилагательное young образует превосходную степень с помощью суффикса -est (the youngest), а не слова most.

prompt: Was Tuesday (cold) day of your whole winter trip in Scotland?
explanation_ru: Вторник сравнивается со всеми днями поездки (of your whole winter trip), поэтому нужна превосходная степень the coldest.

prompt: Students in the back study room work (quietly) of all, and they get (little / noise) than people near the entrance.
explanation_ru: Конструкция of all требует превосходной степени наречия (the most quietly), а союз than с неисчисляемым существительным noise — сравнительной формы less noise.

prompt: "Which of the four villages lies (far) from town?" "Ballymore does, so coaches arrive there (late) than at the coast."
explanation_ru: Из четырёх деревень выбирается самая дальняя (the furthest / the farthest), а во второй части союз than указывает на сравнение двух точек (later).

prompt: Four holiday cottages were free on the island, and the stone one near the beach felt ___ of all.
explanation_ru: Выражение of all и выбор из четырёх домов требуют превосходной степени длинного прилагательного — the most comfortable. Типичная ошибка — добавлять -est к длинному слову или использовать more.

prompt: Our new club rules are still too strict for beginners, yet the safety page explains the schedule more clearly then the old leaflet.
answer: Our new club rules are still too strict for beginners, yet the safety page explains the schedule more clearly than the old leaflet.
accepted_answers: Our new club rules are still too strict for beginners, yet the safety page explains the schedule more clearly than the old leaflet.
explanation_ru: При сравнении двух вещей используется союз than («чем»), а не наречие времени then («затем»).

prompt: Daria bought a new router and used the setup leaflet throughout the weekend. It helped her slightly at the start, a bit on Sunday, and far more when connecting the printer.
options: The leaflet was more useful than the printer during the whole weekend.
The leaflet was at its most useful when Daria connected the printer.
The leaflet was the usefulest thing Daria read on Saturday morning.
The leaflet was less useful when connecting the printer than at the start.
explanation_ru: По смыслу инструкция пригодилась больше всего именно при подключении принтера, что точно передаёт оборот at its most useful.

prompt: Between the two applicants, Ravi has far more teaching experience than Callum. → Of the two applicants, Ravi is …
answer: Of the two applicants, Ravi is the more experienced.
accepted_answers: Of the two applicants, Ravi is the more experienced.
Of the two applicants, Ravi is the more experienced one.
Of the two applicants, Ravi is the more experienced applicant.
Of the two applicants, Ravi is the more experienced of the two.
explanation_ru: В официальном стиле при сравнении ровно двух людей с оборотом of the two используется артикль the и сравнительная степень (the more experienced).

prompt: The meeting about street parking started badly, and nobody wanted to listen. Our neighbour Tariq suggested painting clear bay lines instead of banning visitors. His idea worked (well) than anyone had expected, and it caused (few / arguments) than the council's plan. In the end, everyone agreed it was (fair) solution of all the proposals on the table.
explanation_ru: Союз than в третьем предложении требует сравнительных форм (better и fewer с исчисляемым существительным arguments), а of all the proposals в конце — превосходной степени (the fairest).

prompt: In our formal review of these two travel backpacks, the lighter model is ___, although it does not hold the most luggage in our catalogue.
options: the most practical of the two
the more practical of the two
explanation_ru: При сравнении ровно двух предметов в официальном стиле используется the + сравнительная степень (the more practical of the two). Частая ошибка — ставить превосходную степень (the most practical) для пары предметов.

prompt: Of all the candidates for the community manager role, Fatima explains complex plans (clearly), yet Ewan brings (many / contacts) to the team than she does.
explanation_ru: Оборот Of all the candidates задаёт превосходную степень наречия (the most clearly), а сравнение двух кандидатов с союзом than — сравнительную форму (more contacts).

prompt: We opened our local play to a full hall, and nine critics published notes online. Have you compared the two newspaper reviews yet? Between those two pieces, the Sunday critic judged the acting (strictly) than the Friday writer. Across all nine reviews, however, the student blog wrote (critical) summary of the whole show and gave us (few / stars) of anyone.
explanation_ru: Две газетные рецензии сравниваются через more strictly than, а среди всех девяти отзывов используются превосходные формы the most critical и the fewest stars (для исчисляемого существительного).

prompt: Our university team studied cycling habits across the city without relying on a single method. The online survey reached (many / residents) of all three stages in the project. However, our short street interviews did not stay on the surface: cyclists explained their daily routes (honestly) than on the short paper forms. Because of that, the interview team also spent (long) analysing the notes than the survey group did.
explanation_ru: Из трёх этапов выделяется максимальный охват (the most residents), а далее два метода сравниваются между собой с помощью союза than и сравнительных наречий (more honestly, longer).

prompt: The town museum keeps a hundred historic maps of the coast in a cool basement room. This hand-drawn chart of the harbour is (third / old) item in the whole collection. Surprisingly, its dark ink has survived (well) than the paint on maps drawn a century later. During school visits, pupils always study its tiny ship drawings (closely) of all the displays on the wall.
explanation_ru: В коллекции из ста карт используется порядковая превосходная степень (the third-oldest) и превосходное наречие (the most closely), а при сопоставлении с более новыми картами через than — сравнительное наречие better.
